'''An Unidentified''' [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Karrid]] during the [[Galactic War]] around [[3640 BBY]]. He and his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] over [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|battle of Duro]] that took place that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].

==Biography==
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], his master's former Jedi Mentor, boarded the [[Ascendant Spear]] while the ship was docked at [[Reaver Station]], the Human male fought [[Gnost-Dural]], with the help of his fellow [[Unidentified Sith Pureblood female Sith apprentice|Sith Apprentice]] and some help from his master, [[Darth Karrid]]. The trio eventually captured [[Gnost-Dural]] and began to interrogate him.

Later on, when [[Gnost-Dural]] had escaped from his captors with the help of Theron Shan, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith Apprentice]], who at the time was helping his [[Darth Karrid|master]] to control the [[Ascendant Spear]], was interrupted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]. With the help of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Quux]] and [[Ordez]], he fought the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but in the end, Master [[Gnost-Dural]] overpowered and defeated him with a slash to the mid-rim.
